summary.oneLiner: Ahmedabad-based manufacturer and trader of sulphur based inorganic chemicals (bisulphites and sulphites) in food and technical grades, selling to domestic and export markets.
summary.business: Shanti Inorganics Limited manufactures and trades sulphur based inorganic chemicals, with a product portfolio of ammonium bisulphite, sodium bisulphite solutions, sodium meta/bisulphite and sodium sulphite powder. These are used as preservatives, reducing agents, oxygen scavengers and process intermediates across oil drilling, pharmaceuticals, food and beverages, pulp & paper and water treatment. Products are supplied in two grades, food grade and technical grade, to customers in India and in export markets including Azerbaijan, Colombia, Egypt, Eswatini, Iraq, Turkey, Malaysia, Nigeria, …
